channel.title: UK SEW: Journal
channel.description: Guides and stories on sewing machines, parts, servicing, wool and Leicester’s hosiery heritage, from the UK SEW journal. New posts every month.

item.title: How to choose a sewing machine
item.description: Choosing your first or next sewing machine? Our UK guide covers machine types, the features that matter, budgets, new vs used, and getting expert local advice.

item.title: How to thread a sewing machine
item.description: How to thread a sewing machine correctly: spool, guides, tension discs, take-up lever and needle, then winding the bobbin and raising the thread.

item.title: Knit + Stitch Harrogate 2026
item.description: Knit + Stitch (formerly The Knitting & Stitching Show) comes to Harrogate on 19 to 22 November 2026. Dates, what to expect and tips for buying at the show.

item.title: How often should you service a sewing machine?
item.description: How often to service a home or industrial sewing machine, what a service involves, warning signs to watch for and what you can safely do yourself.

item.title: What is denier? Tights and hosiery explained
item.description: What denier means in tights and stockings, how sheer 10 denier compares with opaque 60, plus fibres, sizing and how to make hosiery last longer.

item.title: Domestic vs industrial sewing machines
item.description: Domestic and industrial sewing machines compared: speed, stitch types, motors, space, noise and cost, so you can choose the right machine for home or business.

item.title: How to clean a sewing machine
item.description: Clean your sewing machine safely: what you need, removing lint from feed dogs and the bobbin area, when to oil, what not to do, and when to book a service.

item.title: How socks are made, step by step
item.description: How socks are made today: yarn, circular knitting machines, heel and toe shaping, toe closing, boarding and pairing, plus the Leicester connection.

item.title: Sewing machine needles explained
item.description: A clear guide to sewing machine needles: domestic and industrial systems, sizes like 80/12 and 100/16, and points for jersey, denim, leather and embroidery.

item.title: Leicester sheep and the story of British wool
item.description: How Leicestershire shaped British wool: Robert Bakewell’s Leicester Longwool, the prized Bluefaced Leicester, and how UK fleece is graded today.

item.title: Buying a used sewing machine: the checklist
item.description: Buying a second-hand sewing machine in the UK? What to check, questions to ask, dealer vs private sale, your consumer rights and why servicing matters.

item.title: Setting up a sewing room
item.description: How to set up a sewing room or corner at home: table height, lighting, power, cutting and pressing stations, fabric and thread storage, and a comfortable chair.

item.title: Quilting for beginners: your first quilt
item.description: A beginner’s guide to quilting in the UK: tools, fabric, accurate ¼-inch seams, layering and basting, quilting with a walking foot and binding your first quilt.

item.title: How Leicester clothed the world
item.description: The story of Leicester’s hosiery industry: framework knitters, factory giants like Corah and Wolsey, and why the city became a byword for knitted goods.

item.title: Sewing machine tension made simple
item.description: Understand sewing machine tension: how a balanced stitch looks, fixing loops and puckering, adjusting top and bobbin tension, and when to get help.

item.title: Corah and St Margaret’s Works
item.description: How Nathaniel Corah’s hosiery business grew into St Margaret’s Works, one of the largest knitting factories in Britain and a long-time Marks & Spencer supplier.

item.title: Sewing with jersey and knits
item.description: How to sew jersey and knit fabrics on a regular sewing machine or overlocker: needles, stitches, walking foot, stabilising seams and hemming with a twin needle.

item.title: Starting an alterations business: the equipment checklist
item.description: The machines and tools you need to start a clothing alterations or tailoring business in the UK, from lockstitch and overlocker to pressing kit and spares.

item.title: Framework knitting museums to visit
item.description: Visit the Wigston Framework Knitters Museum near Leicester and the Framework Knitters Museum in Ruddington to see where Britain’s hosiery industry began.

item.title: William Lee and the stocking frame
item.description: How William Lee’s stocking frame of 1589 mechanised knitting, why Elizabeth I refused him a patent, and how it led to the East Midlands hosiery industry.

item.title: Wool and yarn weights explained
item.description: UK yarn weights explained with US equivalents, needle sizes and the best uses for each, plus how to read a ball band and why a tension square matters.

item.title: An overlocker beginner’s guide
item.description: New to overlockers (sergers)? Learn what they do, 3- and 4-thread stitches, differential feed, threading order and the most common beginner mistakes to avoid.

item.title: Leicester Made 2026 and the future of UK textiles
item.description: Leicester Made & Regions 2026 brought UK manufacturers, knitters and brands to De Montfort University. What happened and why onshore textile making matters.

item.title: Sewing machine hire vs buy
item.description: Should you hire or buy a sewing machine? We compare short-term rental, buying new and buying a tested used machine for projects, courses and small businesses.

item.title: Common sewing machine problems and fixes
item.description: Skipped stitches, thread bunching, breaking needles or fabric not feeding? Simple fixes for common sewing machine problems, and when to call an engineer.

item.title: Inspired by the Sewing Bee? Start here
item.description: Watched The Great British Sewing Bee and want to start sewing? The kit you need, first projects, classes and how to choose a first machine without overspending.

item.title: Bobbins and bobbin cases explained
item.description: Class 15, class 66, L-style and M-style bobbins explained, plus metal vs plastic, drop-in vs front-loading, and why the wrong bobbin ruins your stitches.

item.title: Selling or part-exchanging a sewing machine
item.description: Upgrading or clearing a workroom? How to value, sell or part-exchange a domestic or industrial sewing machine, and what dealers look for before making an offer.

item.title: The presser feet you really need
item.description: Zipper, buttonhole, walking, invisible zip, rolled hem and more: the presser feet worth owning, plus how to check low, high and slant shank before you buy.

item.title: Industrial sewing machine maintenance
item.description: A practical daily, weekly and periodic maintenance routine for industrial sewing machines: oiling, cleaning, needles, belts and when to call an engineer.
